about: measure contests of 2018 in Michigan, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, 2018 precinct-level returns, GitHub MEDSL/2018-elections-official at commit 42055b11dcd5
medsl.licence: no licence file in the repository; MEDSL's Dataverse sets of the same year are CC0 1.0
medsl.note: MEDSL's own earlier release, read by git (the repository now points to its Dataverse sets, which sit behind a guestbook; pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py --compare-dataverse matches the files by MD5); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files 2018-mi-precinct-general.zip

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

question.title: State Proposal - 18-1: Legislative Initiative: Coalition To Regulate Marijuana Like Alcohol

threshold.quote: Any law submitted to the people by either initiative or referendum petition and approved by a majority of the votes cast thereon at any election shall take effect 10 days after the date of the official declaration of the vote.
threshold.matched: by the type the source's title states (statute)

p.not_computed: fewer than 100 like measures in earlier years in the sources taken in (83) for the class 'statewide measure'

question.title: State Proposal - 18-2: Constitutional Amendment: Voters Not Politicians

threshold.rule: majority of electors voting on the amendment
threshold.citation: Mich. Const. art. XII, §1, or Mich. Const. art. XII, §2
threshold.quote: If a majority of electors voting on a proposed amendment approve the same, it shall become part of the constitution

also_governs.applies_to: constitutional amendment proposed by initiative petition
also_governs.quote: If the proposed amendment is approved by a majority of the electors voting on the question, it shall become part of the constitution

threshold.matched: by the type the source's title states (amendment); the source does not show which of these governs it (Mich. Const. art. XII, §1: constitutional amendment proposed by the legislature; Mich. Const. art. XII, §2: constitutional amendment proposed by initiative petition), and each sets this share

p.not_computed: fewer than 100 like measures in earlier years in the sources taken in (83) for the class 'statewide measure'
